material_results.interpretation: B01 produced a result, but full independent-oracle agreement over the frozen probe set did not satisfy the R2 certificate. The close split-adaptive/mpmath witness agreement is positive diagnostic evidence only.

common_failure_interpretation.finding: For B12, O13 and O14 the frozen split-adaptive oracle failed before producing a qualification result at the common control h_surface=0 cm, h_top=-100 cm. The lower q endpoint was machine-nextafter above KSAT, where K/(K-q) has a numerically singular endpoint layer. Direct adaptive head quadrature emitted convergence/roundoff warnings and returned same-sign bracket residuals.
common_failure_interpretation.required_repair: Resolve q-KSAT in a logarithmic positive coordinate and use endpoint-robust, independently implemented path integrals before interpreting any 5 cm surface-to-unsaturated candidate discrepancy.

hard_nonclaims: R2 does not falsify the inherited legacy steady_q reference.
R2 does not qualify or falsify the Ross candidate face.
The prior 5 cm boundary-face failure remains binding until a valid independent oracle and fresh qualification exist.
No finite-positive ponding-head, surface-process, runoff or production admission follows from R2.
No R2 threshold is relaxed after observing the failures.
